items.title: Neverness to Everness lets players drive a tank, run a delivery service, and dive a cyberspace ocean today
NTE codes November 2026
items.summary: Our list of Neverness to Everness (NTE) codes and 1.2 livestream codes will help you claim free Annulith, which will help you roll for new S-Class characters.
items.content:
Image credit: Hotta Studio Guide by Dion Dassanayake Contributing Guides Writer Updated on Nov. 11, 2026, 2:51 p.m. Follow Neverness to Everness Prioritise us on Google 11th November 2026 : We added new NTE codes. Neverness to Everness codes will help you claim free Annulith so you can roll for new characters in the GTA-like gacha game. The free-to-play RPG is set in a Tokyo-like metropolis known as Hethereau, where supernatural events known as Anomalies occur.

While it's up to you to hunt down these Anomalies, the game is all about player freedom and there's tonnes of other things you can do including street races, taking on part-time jobs and buying your own luxury apartment. There's even a GTA-style wanted system and you can end up in jail! If you need a hand on your adventures, you can always use NTE codes to get rewards like free Annulith which will help you roll for new S-Class characters. Codes are shared on the official NTE Discord server , but to save you time we've rounded up the latest codes below including the NTE 1.5 livestream codes .

Here are all the working NTE codes as of 11th November 2026:

Think we can make our code pages better? Help us level up by taking our quick survey .

Neverness to Everness players could also claim free rewards that were shared in the 1.5 livestream. These NTE livestream codes were only available for a limited amount of time, so you needed to be quick in redeeming them!

Here's all of the NTE 1.5 livestream codes, which have now expired:

The NTE 1.5 livestream codes, which were shared in an online broadcast that detailed the 'Once Upon a Glitched Call' update , were only available until 3.59pm GMT on Sunday 1st November 2026.

Not sure how to redeem codes in Neverness to Everness? Here's what you need to do:

Run out of NTE codes to redeem? If you pre-registered for NTE then you'll have plenty of extra freebies waiting for you in your inbox.

Simply head to the 'Mail' section and find the message titled 'Pre-Reg Milestone Rewards' to claim the goodies. Here's everything you can get if you pre-registered:

Besides NTE codes, you can also get freebies for Neverness to Everness at launch by taking advantage of Twitch Drops. Twitch Drops let you claim rewards for NTE by watching participating streams.

If this sounds like something you're interested in, then here's what you need to do:

The number of rewards you get depends on how long you watch a participating stream. Here's the NTE rewards you can get and how long you need to watch a Twitch stream to get it:

Once you've unlocked a reward, you'll need to head to your Twitch Drops Inventory and claim it so you receive it in-game.

items.title: New Character 'Elyms' Debuts in 'Neverness to Everness' Version 1.5 Update
items.summary: Neverness to Everness updated to Version 1.5, "Once Upon a Glitched Call," on November 11, introducing the new character Elyms and a new main story chapter.
items.content:
Korean (한국어) KO Add us on ⓒ Perfect World Neverness to Everness updated to Version 1.5, "Once Upon a Glitched Call," on November 11, introducing the new character Elyms and a new main story chapter. In the second half of the update, S-Rank character EXE and four-player battle content will also be introduced sequentially.

Developed by Perfect World subsidiary Hotta Studio, the supernatural urban open-world RPG Neverness to Everness revealed its new main story, "Digital Sea: Where We Meet Again," in this update. Players explore an anomalous space made of data alongside ETD Team 6 while unraveling mysteries surrounding an urban legend. As the story progresses, players uncover clues about Elyms' true identity and her connection to EXE, while experiencing a new side of Hethereau, a city where humans coexist with Anomalies.

The new S-Rank character Elyms is the lieutenant of ETD Team 6 and an Anomaly herself. A Light-element, fast-cycling character, she uses a mobile phone as her hidden weapon. As her "Signal Strength"—which dictates her combat stance—grows stronger, both her damage output and buff effects are enhanced accordingly.

To mark the character's arrival, the limited-time board "Android Dreams" is now open. On this board, players can obtain a limited glider, vehicle livery, and a new outfit for Elyms. In the Arc Research Program "Echo Special," the drop rate for the limited S-Rank Arc "Echoes on Hold" is increased.

New vehicles and follow-up content have also been added. The Blind Box now includes the "Iron Ogre" and "Prototype Land Overlord 001". In the second half of the version update, along with EXE joining the roster, logistics management content "City Express" and four-player battle content "Smooth Sailing" will be updated sequentially.

Further details regarding the update can be found on the official Neverness to Everness website and game lounge.

items.content:
Hey Appraiser,

NTE will undergo maintenance on Nov 11, 06:00 – 11:00 (UTC+8). Once it's done, the all-new Version 1.5 "Once Upon a Glitched Call" goes live. "Pink Paws Heist" will be temporarily unavailable starting Nov 11, 05:30 (UTC+8) and will reopen once maintenance wraps up.

Login will be unavailable during this period, so please plan accordingly. Since this is a large update, please keep your data plan in mind when choosing between Wi-Fi and mobile data. We apologize for any inconvenience.

※ Akane Rin's "Dazzling Star" Limited Board is available until Nov 11, 2026, 05:59 (UTC+8). Be sure to visit the Void Perks event page to redeem the cosmetic rewards from this board before the event ends.

\

● Maintenance Period: Nov 11, 2026, 06:00 – 11:00 (UTC+8)

● Maintenance Compensation: Annulith x300

● Eligibility: Appraisers who created a character before Nov 11, 2026, 06:00 (UTC+8)

● Distribution: Sent via in-game mail after maintenance. Be sure to claim the items before they expire.

※ Maintenance may end earlier or later than scheduled depending on actual progress. Please keep an eye on our official announcements for updates.

● Bug Fix Compensation: Annulith x300

● Eligibility: Appraisers who created a character before Nov 11, 2026, 06:00 (UTC+8)

● Distribution: Sent via in-game mail after maintenance. Be sure to claim the items before they expire.

\

Steam: Close the game, exit and restart the Steam client, go to your Library, find NTE, and click Update to start the download.

\

1. New Character & Arc

● New Limited S-Class Character: Elyms

Availability: Nov 11 (after update) – Dec 2, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Unlock Requirement: Complete the main story quest "Prologue - A New Destination - Head to Eibon Antique Shop"

Board Details: The "Android Dreams" Limited Board features the S-class character Elyms, along with A-class characters Mint, Edgar, and Adler.

During the event, the "Android Dreams" Limited Board also features the "Joy Buoy" glider, the "+Friend & Rescue+" Novus A001 livery, and Elyms's "Drifting Petals" outfit. Reach 50, 120, and 200 total rolls to claim each reward directly from the Skin Perks event page, or obtain them early with lucky rolls on the board.

*For full details, head to Scarborough Fair in-game.

● New Limited S-Class Arc: Echoes on Hold

Availability: Nov 11 (after update) – Dec 2, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Unlock Requirement: Complete the main story quest "Prologue - A New Destination - Head to Eibon Antique Shop"

Research Guide: Spend Tri-Keys or Echo Keys to participate in the "Echo Special" Arc Research Program and obtain the limited S-Class Arc "Echoes on Hold". This Arc is currently only available through this program.

*For full details, head to Arc Shop › Arc Research Program in-game.

● Limited S-Class Character Rerun: Shinku

Availability: Nov 11 (after update) – Dec 2, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Unlock Requirement: Complete the main story quest "Prologue - A New Destination - Head to Eibon Antique Shop"

Board Details: The "Before the Dawn" Limited Board features the exclusive S-class character Shinku, along with A-class characters Mint, Edgar, and Adler.

During the event, the "Before the Dawn" Limited Board also features the "Overcast Canopy" glider livery, the "Hidden Dragon" Blizzard-V4 livery, and Shinku's outfit "Student of Terrasea". Claim them from the Resolve Perks page by accumulating 50/120/200 rolls, or obtain them randomly through rolls before reaching these milestones.

※ Only rolls on the "Before the Dawn" Limited Board count toward Resolve Perks progress. Each board is tracked independently, and progress carries over between boards with the same name.

*For full details, head to Scarborough Fair in-game.

● Limited S-Class Arc Rerun: Blushing Mirage

Availability: Nov 11 (after update) – Dec 2, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Unlock Requirement: Complete the main story quest "Prologue - A New Destination - Head to Eibon Antique Shop"

Research Guide: Spend Tri-Keys or Resolve Keys to participate in the "Resolve Special" Arc Research Program and obtain the limited S-Class Arc "Blushing Mirage". This Arc is currently only available through this program.

*For full details, head to Arc Shop › Arc Research Program in-game.

2. New Story

● New Main Story Episode: "Meet Me in the Data Stream"

It started as a faded urban legend, people kept dreaming of old friends who left behind an "invalid number".

Try calling it and, sure enough, the line is dead. Yet in your dream, a different call comes through...

Have the captain and lieutenant of ETD-6 really gone dark on a classified mission? Is a high-level anomaly behind it all, or an anomaly crime at play?

"You want your friend back... don't you?"

Available: After the Version 1.5 update

Unlock Requirement: Complete the main story episode "The Witch"

● City Hangouts

New City Hangouts story featuring Elyms

Available: After the Version 1.5 update

Unlock Requirement: Obtain Elyms and reach the required Bond Level

● Home Time

A new invitation mode featuring Elyms

Available: After the Version 1.5 update

Unlock Requirement: Obtain Elyms and reach the required Bond Level

3. New Stages

● New Anomaly Pilgrimage: Amber Broodmother

Available: After the Version 1.5 update

Unlock Requirement: Complete the main story episode "Fogden Game"

4. New Outfits & Accessories

● New Elyms Outfit "Y2K Mystique" Added to Shop

Discount Period: Nov 11 (after update) – Dec 23, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Discount Price: Riftcrystal x2,680

Original Price: Riftcrystal x3,280 (18% off, limited time)

Shop Availability: Permanent

● New Elyms Outfit "Drifting Petals"

How to Get: While the "Android Dreams" Limited Board is active, roll on the board and land on the matching tile to obtain the outfit, or claim it from the Dialing Perks event page once you've accumulated enough rolls.

● New Elyms Outfit "Windflower"

How to Get: Unlocked after you obtain Elyms and reach Bond Lvl 10 with her.

● New Vehicles "Iron Ogre" & "Prototype Land Overlord 001"

How to Get: Available from "Open Roads Ahead" Mystery Boxes.

● New Accessory "Tiny Friend"

How to Get: Unlocked after reaching 3,000 total progress in the "Fortune's Bounty" event.

● New Accessory "Eagle Eye"

How to Get: Purchase the "Forward Momentum Skin Bundle" in Mall › Gift Center.

5. New Mystery Box Event "Open Roads Ahead"

Duration: Nov 11 (after update) – Dec 23, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Details: Spend Fons or Annulith to open "Open Roads Ahead" Mystery Boxes. Your first box costs Fons x50,000 or Annulith x50, and the price climbs with each one after. There are 15 boxes in total, and opening all of them unlocks every reward in the pool.

Mystery Box Contents: The "Open Roads Ahead" Mystery Boxes feature the vehicles "Iron Ogre" and "Prototype Land Overlord 001", the Iron Ogre livery "Caution: Graffiti!", the avatar frame "Wayfinder", the namecard "The Open Road", Fabricated Dice, A Handwritten Letter, Anomaly Pilgrimage Material Selection Box, and more.

6. New Events

● "Circle Gifts" Login Event

Duration: Nov 11 (after update) – Dec 23, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Details: Log in for a total of 7 days to earn Solid Dice x10.

● "City Logistics" Limited-Time Event

Duration: Nov 11 (after update) – Dec 23, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Details: From a single delivery truck to an entire city. During the event, complete limited-time quests to earn the event currency "Kool" tokens, and finish all limited-time quests to claim the namecard "Big Dreams". Spend Kool tokens in the Event Shop to redeem the vehicle "C001", the title "Hethereau Delivery King", the phone case "Five-Star Reviews", the phone wallpaper "Next Order!", the avatar "Kool", the avatar frame "The Boss Is In", Fabricated Dice, and more. Raise your Reputation Level to earn additional rewards, including the vehicle "Ori-LV03", Annulith, Floe Cinema Ticket, Elite Hunter Guide, and Chaotic Dye.

● "Hunter's Crucible: Breakthrough" Limited-Time Event

Duration: Nov 11 (after update) – Dec 23, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Details: During the event, clear challenge stages to earn rewards, including the event title "Hunter's Crucible - Blade Honed", Annulith, Fabricated Dice, Fons, Elite Hunter Guides, and Chaotic Dye.

※ The visual effect of the event title "Hunter's Crucible - Blade Honed" changes based on your total event points.

● "Full Tank Ahead" Limited-Time Event

Event Duration: Nov 19, 10:00 – Dec 23, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Details: A special launch event for the TerraX "Iron Ogre". Take the wheel and fight to be king of the hill! During the event, participate to earn the event currency "TX Token", which can be redeemed in the Event Shop for Annulith, Floe Cinema Ticket, Fons, Elite Hunter Guides, Chaotic Dye, and more.

● "Fishing Frenzy" Limited-Time Event

Duration: Nov 23, 05:00 – Dec 23, 05:59 (server time)

Details: There's more than one way to catch a fish. During the event, head to the "Sea Angler" fishing spot at Nacupeda Park to take part and raise your fishing level for rewards including Annulith, Floe Cinema Tickets, Elite Hunter Guides, Chaotic Dye, Manhole Boss, and more!

● "Pixel Surge" Limited-Time Event

Event Duration: Nov 16, 05:00 – Nov 23, 04:59 (server time)

Details: During the event, spend Character Pixels in "Houdinii's Magic Stage", "Houdinii's Schemes", "Bubble Can Factory", and "Rabbit Hole" to receive double the rewards.

Each day, double rewards apply to up to 120 Character Pixels spent. Unused daily allowance carries over, up to a total cap of 840 Character Pixels for the whole event.

● "Gold Clash" Limited-Time Event

Duration: Nov 23, 05:00 – Dec 7, 04:59 (server time)

Details: During the event, earn Fons at 2x efficiency in "Pink Paws Heist".

7. Other Content

● "Fortune's Bounty" Event

Duration: Nov 11 (after update) – Dec 23, 05:59 (server time)

Details: Take part during the event to earn "Fortune Coins". Reach progress milestones to claim rewards including the open-world interactable item "Pop-Up Divination House", the accessory "Tiny Friend", the tire tracks "Hyperflame", the tire smoke "Neonbula", Solid Dice, Fabricated Dice, Anomaly Pilgrimage Material Selection Box II, Anomaly Hunt Material Selection Box, Fons, and more!

● Version 1.5 "Circle Bounty" Guide

Duration: Nov 11 (after update) – Dec 22, 23:59 (UTC+8)

Requirement: Complete the Main Quest "Relax Time"

Details: During the event, complete Circle Quests to earn Experience Points and raise your Circle Bounty Rank, unlocking Fabricated Dice, Gold Carrota, De-noise Solution, A Handwritten Letter, Eternal Shell Song, Development EXP Selection Box I, Expansion Core, and more.

Purchase "Elite Hunter Supplies" to unlock additional rewards as you rank up, including Annulith x680, Solid Dice x4, Fabricated Dice x2, Arc-light Trove II x1, A Handwritten Letter x2, Fons x950,000, and more!

Purchase this season's "Honor Hunter Supplies" to get all the extra rewards listed above, plus instantly receive the avatar "Long Time No See", the avatar frame "Who's Calling?", the namecard "City of Wonders", Fabricated Dice x5, A Handwritten Letter x1, and Fons x500,000!

※ Open Arc-light Trove II to choose one of the following: Fluff of Fearlessness, Fluff of Fleetness, Fluff of Finesse, Fluff of Ferocity, Fluff of Fortitude, or Fons x2,000,000.

\

◆ Add guitar recording, music share code, and Bagel sharing features for Akane Rin.

◆ Skill optimization for Shinku's passive "Menacing Gaze": When entering or retrying a stage in Beyond the Rails, Menacing Gaze now starts at max stacks without needing to build up stacks from scratch.

◆ Add PVP rank system to Volley Star.

◆ Add collectible showcase, in-match reporting, and match history to "Going, Going, Gone!", along with the new auction assistant, Elyms.

◆ Add new collectibles to "Going, Going, Gone!" and adjusted the appearance rates of certain collectibles.

◆ Add AI opponent backfill to "Shadow-n-Seek" when matchmaking exceeds a certain wait time, and randomize the spawn locations of certain objects in each match.

◆ Add overflow storage for City Stamina and Character Pixels: Excess City Stamina is now stored as City Stamina Reserve (up to 1,000), and excess Character Pixels are stored as Photo Paper Supply (up to 2,400).

◆ Add a Resource Overview feature, allowing Appraisers to check their earning progress for Annulith, Solid Dice, Fabricated Dice, and Tri-Key in the current version, with shortcuts to the corresponding events or mini-games (total progress display on Mac and iOS will be added in a future update).

◆ Add a new open-world interactable item, the "Pop-Up Divination House", which Appraisers can place or pack up at any time (unlocked by reaching 5,100 total progress in the "Fortune's Bounty" event).

◆ Character rendering optimizations: Add support for Snapdragon ANF on mobile, and NVIDIA RTX Spark and AMD FSR 4 on PC.

◆ Add the ability to level up character Esper Abilities to specific target levels.

◆ Add Upgrade Targets for characters.

◆ Add a free-roam mode to the vehicle auto-drive system.

◆ Add one-click furniture purchasing when importing a Blueprint.

◆ Add a playback timing toggle for "First Meeting Replay" to play a character's unlock animation immediately (enable this in Settings › Control).

◆ Add a one-click option to delete Map Pins.

◆ Add Bond quests for Elyms.

◆ Add new Bond interactions for Elyms: reach the required Bond Level to unlock her passenger seat ride-along feature.

◆ Add a combat tutorial for Elyms.

◆ When multiple Arc Research Programs are available at the same time, the Key item display in the top-right corner will update automatically to match the selected program.

◆ Tweak the third-person driving camera angle for the vehicle "Ori-LV03".

◆ Make certain accessories compatible with more characters.

◆ Optimize item source shortcuts so they now take you directly to the corresponding challenge stages.

◆ Optimize the visual presentation of reward items obtained upon a character's 6th Awakening.

◆ Improve controller support across in-game menus.

◆ Fix an issue where Dodge and Critical Riposte could not chain into subsequent Basic Attack hits while holding Basic Attack with the character Akane Rin.

◆ Fix an issue in the Anomaly Hunt "Black Tome" battle where casting Linko's Redirect Skill and selecting Xiaozhen for a Synced Strike while a character was shackled by the boss caused an abnormal DMG boost.

◆ Fix an issue where Shinku could occasionally display an abnormal animation while gliding.

◆ Fix an issue in multiplayer where players could not deal damage when attacking one of the "Huggy Vines" anomalies at Serenetti Manor.

◆ Fix crashes that could occur in certain situations.

◆ Improve localization for several languages.

◆ Fix other known issues.

items.title: Happy Halloween! Brave a Spine-Chilling Adventure in Spooky Cookies
items.summary: Hey, Appraisers! 🎃 Happy Halloween! To mark the occasion, we've released a special Halloween illustration. Come get into the spooky spirit with us! And that's not all: Spooky Cookies, Pukaland's haunted funhouse, is now open! The park's Sh
items.content:
Hey, Appraisers!

🎃 Happy Halloween!

To mark the occasion, we've released a special Halloween illustration. Come get into the spooky spirit with us!

And that's not all: Spooky Cookies, Pukaland's haunted funhouse, is now open!

The park's Shadowy Guests have taken up residence inside, and word has it they aren't fond of letting intruders leave. Only courage and quick wits will get you out in one piece.

Enter at your own risk, and good luck in there.

Event Details:

Explore Spooky Cookies in first person and work your way through each stage. Use your special flashlight to figure out how to open the exit, then make your escape!

The flashlight drains its battery while in use, and you can switch between different lighting modes.

UV Light mode drains the battery faster but reveals invisible Ghost Butlers and hidden mechanisms. Spend a chunk of battery to unleash a powerful flash that briefly stuns most Ghost Butlers and triggers special interactions with certain mechanisms in the house. The flash ability has a short cooldown.

items.summary: The "Dazzling Star" Limited Board is coming soon! Roll for a chance to get Akane Rin, the featured limited S-class character! ● Available October 21, 2026 (after update) – November 11, 2026, 05:59 (UTC+8) ● Unlock Requirement Complete the E
items.content:
The "Dazzling Star" Limited Board is coming soon! Roll for a chance to get Akane Rin, the featured limited S-class character!

● Available

October 21, 2026 (after update) – November 11, 2026, 05:59 (UTC+8)

● Unlock Requirement

Complete the Episode Quest "Prologue: A New Destination - Head to Eibon Antique Shop"

● Featuring

1. The "Dazzling Star" board features the limited S-class character Akane Rin, along with A-class characters Haniel, Aurelia, and Skia.

2. Also on the "Dazzling Star" board: "Day Adrift" glider, "Starbeat Rush" Yesteryear bike livery, and Akane's "Shining Idol" outfit.

● Board Rules

1. The "Dazzling Star" board uses Solid Dice or Void Dice. Roll to move 1–6 tiles (equal chance), land on a tile, and claim the displayed reward.

2. All Limited Boards share the same S-class character pity counter, Points Gift progress, and Board Modification progress.

3. Skin Perks for the "Dazzling Star" board are time-limited and exclusive to this board. Progress does not carry over to other Limited Boards. Skin Perks for this board include: Daily Outfit, Mod Up! (Livery), and Fashion Center.

4. All boards start as Baseline. If the featured S-class character doesn't drop within 70 consecutive rolls, the board upgrades to Modified (rate up). Once you obtain the featured S-class character, the board resets to Baseline.

5. If you haven't obtained the featured S-class character after 89 rolls, your 90th roll automatically grants them (your piece will not move). The featured S-class character is guaranteed within 90 rolls.

6. Akane Rin is currently only available from the "Dazzling Star" Limited Board, with no other ways to obtain her planned at this time.

*For full details, head to Scarborough Fair in-game.

items.content:
Welcome to Pukaland, where your magical journey begins! Collect Wonder Stamps and unlock your exclusive park memories.

● Available

September 30 (after update) – November 11, 05:59 (UTC+8)

● Rewards

During the event, complete limited-time encounters to earn Annulith, Fabricated Dice, Floe Cinema Tickets, Elite Hunter Guides, Chaotic Dye, and more.

●Pukaland Gameplay Overview

Candy Jar Raid

"In Candy Jar Raid, press the corresponding Movement keys to rotate your view, and hold the Shoot key to fire. Switch between Cannonballs and Forks depending on the situation.

Use Cannonballs to knock back approaching octopus tentacles and protect the cup's Durability. Use Forks to collect Treasure Chests and Treasure Maps for points. Be careful—if the cup's Durability reaches zero, the game will end early with a low rating."

"If a powerful tentacle grabs you, quickly repel the other attacking tentacles to avoid losing a large amount of points and durability.

Collect all Treasure Maps to unlock a special challenge stage. Defeat all Golden Tentacles to clear the challenge and unlock a special ending. Give it your all!"

Flora Maze

"In Flora Maze, players spawn at random locations, and the maze layout changes each round.

Explore the maze, find the exit, and escape! Collect all the scattered playing cards and rescue every trapped Pukaboo to earn additional rewards."

"Lollipop Goggles reveal the location of the exit, but also make the timer run faster. Pick up other items to gain more time. Approach special bushes to uncover hidden paths—but be careful, some bushes move on their own!

If you fail to escape before time runs out, the challenge will end early with a low rating. Good luck out there!"

Pixies Waltz

"In Pixies Waltz, press the corresponding direction when the green cursor reaches the center of the button to build Firepower.

Your timing will be rated Perfect, Normal, or Miss."

"Reach the top of the tower to enter first-person shooting mode. Spend Firepower to shoot down airborne candy and earn points!

If half of the Firepower you gain in a single run is earned with a Perfect rating, a special challenge stage will unlock. Clear it to reach the special ending. Give it your best shot!"

Punchulum Ride

"In the Punchulum Ride, press the corresponding Movement key when each circle appears to earn points.

There are three types of inputs: press, hold, and repeated press. Watch the colors carefully to know which one to use.

Pink Candy Ring: Press once

Blue Candy Ring: Hold

Orange Candy Ring: Press repeatedly"

"Mistakes increase your character's Fear, while successful inputs reduce it. If Fear gets too high, the game will end early and you'll receive a low rating.

Land multiple Perfects to unlock a special challenge stage. Clear it to reach the special ending. Give it your best shot!"

Lavaton Gold Rush

In Lavaton Gold Rush, use the Movement and Jump keys to control the mine cart. Switch between adjacent tracks to dodge obstacles, pick up weapons to destroy them, and collect coins to earn points.

"While airborne, you can steer the mine cart left or right to choose which track to land on, though your movement will be limited during lava eruptions. On steep tracks, press the Speed Up key to make it up the slope.

Hitting obstacles or derailing will cost you points. Lose too many points, and the game will end early with a low score."
